title: Philips TPM191E (TP Vision, device PH9M_EA_5599, MediaTek mt5887), Europe
notes:
Philips TPM191E (TP Vision, device PH9M_EA_5599, MediaTek mt5887), Europe
Android TV 12 (API 31), firmware STT2.230526.001, security patch 2025-11-01.
Fingerprint: Philips/PH9M_EA_5599/PH9M_EA_5599:12/STT2.230526.001/4215:user/release-keys
About 2 GB RAM, armeabi-v7a. Vendor packages use the org.droidtv prefix.

Not the same board as examples/philips-50pus8517 (PH1M_EA_9970A, Android 11) or
examples/philips-55pus7503 (TPM171E, Android 8); entries shared with those lists were checked
against this TV's own `pm list packages`.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/philips-tpm191e/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/philips-tpm191e/debloat.txt com.google.android.tvlauncher
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher
The uk.co.freeview.* packages and org.droidtv.freeviewplayers are disabled from the factory on
this unit, so they are not listed (restore.sh would turn them ON).

Kept on purpose: org.droidtv.amazonalexa (Alexa power on/off), com.google.android.apps.mediashell
(Chromecast), org.droidtv.oad and com.easy.oad (firmware updates), org.droidtv.eum (see the
philips-50pus8517 list: xtv retries forever without it and the sources drawer dies).

Second unit (same model, firmware STT2.230526.001, Norway, on Ethernet): the whole list applied, with
Prime Video, Assistant and Alexa off by choice. After one reboot every entry stayed disabled except
com.google.android.tvrecommendations, which came back enabled (batch 4). Left as is rather than disabled
again after each boot.

Third unit: Philips 75PUH8265/96, Taiwan, on Ethernet, still on the ANDROID 9 firmware the 2020 sets
shipped with: PTT1.181130.001 build 200260, security patch 2021-11-05. Same device PH9M_EA_5599,
model TPM191E, MediaTek mt5887, about 2 GB RAM.
Fingerprint: Philips/PH9M_EA_5599/PH9M_EA_5599:9/PTT1.181130.001/200260:user/release-keys
- The same 15 Freeview packages were disabled from the factory, on a Taiwanese set too.
- Not installed on this firmware: com.google.android.music, com.phorus.playfi.softap,
org.droidtv.fastip and org.droidtv.aurora (so the 8505 note on fastip does not apply here).
- Disabled from this list: batch 1, batch 2, and batch 3 except dlna. org.droidtv.dlna was KEPT,
following examples/philips-75pus8505 (contentexplorer, "Media", binds it on this board).
tvrecommendations (batch 4) was kept, so the notification panel stays.
- Also disabled on this unit: org.droidtv.amazonalexa (kept above, unused here),
com.google.android.sss.authbridge, org.droidtv.nettvapps, org.droidtv.sticker, and the preloaded
web-app tiles nettvapp1814 (ARTE), 4655 (Deezer), 4771 (Divan.TV), 5326 (Toon Goggles),
5512 (Fishing TV) and 20004410 (Couchplay Games). Labels read with `aapt2 dump badging`.
- launcher/build-and-install.sh ran through on its own on Android 9: the first cold start answered
`am start -W` with Status ok in 2.6 s, unlike the Android 12 timeout in the 8505 notes.
- Idle-loop check after the debloat (philips-50pus8517 quirk 5 method, 30 s): 306 lines, nothing tied
to a disabled package. Most of it was org.droidtv.ambihue driving paired Hue lights, plus
tptvservice's ApplicationSwitchService about once a second.
- Checked the same day; the set has not been restarted since, so persistence across a reboot is
not confirmed for this unit.
